_about: USCIS filing fees the packets and cover letters state (src/fill/cover_letter.py, src/family.py, src/i360.py). Copied from Form G-1055, Fee Schedule, edition 10/01/26 (the firm saved it on 2026-10-01; uscis.gov/g-1055). Paper-filing amounts. The firm mails its packets. 'pl_119_21' fees are the additional fees Public Law 119-21 requires: paid by a SEPARATE payment, never waivable, and they ADJUST EVERY YEAR. Re-check whenever USCIS publishes a new G-1055 edition (docs/maintenance.md). scheduled: increases USCIS has announced with a date (src/fees.py applies each one from its effective date; a packet mailed on or after it states the new amount).
online_source: Form G-1055, edition 10/01/26, each line's 'Online Filing' amount (read 2026-10-02): I-130 general filing $625 (page 9); I-485 general filing $1,390, under 14 with a parent's I-485 $900 (page 15); I-751 general filing $700 (page 22); N-400 general filing $710, no online amount for the reduced fee ('You cannot file online if you are requesting a fee waiver or a reduced fee', page 30); I-131 advance parole with a pending I-485, Part 1 5.A, $580 (Appendix B, page 39); I-765 general $470, with an I-485 filed with its fee on or after April 1, 2024 and pending $260, (c)(8) renewal $470 plus the Pub. L. 119-21 fee (Appendix C, pages 50-51). Only the filings this system can file by PDF upload (schemas/online_filing.json). A Pub. L. 119-21 fee has one amount for both (the same line). A fee with no online amount here is never assumed: the panel says the account shows it.

notes.i765_with_pending_i485_paid: If the I-485 was filed with a fee on or after April 1, 2024 and is still pending: a concurrent family filing.
notes.i765_sij: Initial EAD (c)(9) for a Special Immigrant Juvenile adjusting status, and (c)(14) deferred action filed by an SIJ: $0.
notes.i360_sij: No filing fee for a Special Immigrant Juvenile I-360, but the Pub. L. 119-21 fee ($250 in the 10/01/26 schedule) is due: separate payment, not waivable.
notes.i589: No filing fee for Form I-589; the Pub. L. 119-21 asylum application fee ($100) is due at filing, for the principal applicant only, by separate payment, not for Ms. L. Settlement Class members / QAFMs (G-1055 10/01/26; uscis.gov/i-589).
notes.annual_asylum: Annual Asylum Fee, principal applicant only, for each year the I-589 is pending: due when USCIS sends a notice (pay online within 30 days). Not waivable.
notes.i765_asylum_initial: The Pub. L. 119-21 fee for an initial (c)(8) asylum-applicant work permit, on top of the I-765 fee.
notes.i90: No fee when the card was wrong because of a DHS error, never received and returned undeliverable, or at 14 when the card expires after the 16th birthday (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.i131_advance_parole: With a pending I-485 (Part 1, 5.A) or a pending I-589 (5.B): paper filing (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.i131_rtd_refugee: Refugee travel document for a refugee or a resident through refugee status: no fee; asylees pay $135 (under 16) or $165 (16 and over).
notes.i131_sij: General fee exemption: no fee for ANY reentry permit, travel document or parole document for a person seeking or granted Special Immigrant Juvenile classification or adjustment under INA 245(h) (G-1055 10/01/26, I-131 General Fee Exemptions).
notes.i131_i485_paid_before_2024_04_01: No fee for an advance parole (or refugee travel) document when the client filed the I-485 with its fee on or after July 30, 2007 and before April 1, 2024, and it is still pending (G-1055 10/01/26). CBP may charge the Pub. L. 119-21 Immigration Parole Fee at the port of entry each time parole is sought.
notes.n600: No fee for a current or former service member applying for themself, or for certain adopted children (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.i765_c8_initial: (c)(8) asylum applicant, initial EAD (not the special ABC procedures): $0 filing fee, plus the Pub. L. 119-21 fee ($560; $570 from 10/16/2026) as a separate payment, not waivable (G-1055 10/01/26, Appendix C).
notes.i765_c8_renewal: (c)(8) asylum applicant, renewal EAD: $520 paper, plus the Pub. L. 119-21 renewal fee ($275), separate payment, not waivable (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.i765_a5_initial: (a)(5) asylee, initial EAD: $0 (G-1055 10/01/26). An asylee's renewal is not on the $0 list: the general $520 applies.
notes.i765_c14_sij: (c)(14) deferred action filed by a Special Immigrant Juvenile: $0, initial and renewal (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.i765_i485_paid_before_2024_04_01: Any EAD while an I-485 filed with its fee between 07/30/2007 and 03/31/2024 is pending: $0 (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.i765_replacement_uscis_error: A replacement because USCIS printed the card wrong, or it never arrived through USPS or USCIS error: $0 (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.i765_asylum_renewal: The Pub. L. 119-21 fee for a renewal (c)(8) asylum-applicant EAD, on top of the $520 filing fee (unchanged by the FY 2027 adjustment).
notes.i485_refugee: A refugee (or someone paroled as a refugee) adjusting under INA 209(a), Part 2 item 3.d: $0 (G-1055 10/01/26). An asylee pays the general I-485 fee (i485), or i485_under_14_with_parent.
notes.i290b_sij: A person seeking or granted SIJ: $0 for an I-290B on a benefit request filed before adjusting status, or a motion on the I-485 and an associated ancillary form (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.n336: Form N-336, paper filing (online $780); $0 for an N-400 filed under INA 328 or 329 (military) (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.eoir: EOIR's fees (immigration court and BIA), from EOIR's 'Types of Appeals, Motions, and Required Fees' page, updated October 1, 2026 (data/reference/eoir-fees.txt). NOT the G-1055. Paid only through the EOIR Payment Portal since 02/23/2026. A motion to reopen or reconsider based exclusively on a no-fee relief application: $950. No fee for a motion to reopen under INA 240(b)(5)(C)(ii). The EOIR annual asylum fee is EOIR's figure ($105), ordered by the judge or the Board.
notes.i601a_sij: A person seeking or granted SIJ (or a VAWA self-petitioner): $0 for the I-601A (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.i601: Form I-601, general filing (G-1055 10/01/26, page 20). No biometric services fee at filing (the I-601 instructions, page 3).
notes.i601_exempt: Form I-601, $0 (G-1055 10/01/26, page 20) for a person seeking or granted Special Immigrant Juvenile classification, T or U nonimmigrant status, adjustment as an abused spouse or child under the Cuban Adjustment Act or HRIFA, benefits under NACARA, immigrant classification as a VAWA self-petitioner (including derivatives), or a special immigrant visa or adjustment as an Afghan or Iraqi translator or interpreter, U.S. Government or ISAF employee (or a derivative); also with an I-485 under section 13 of Pub. L. 85-316 (Afghan diplomats with A or G status on 07/14/2021) and for Indochinese refugees under Pub. L. 95-145.
notes.i212: Form I-212, general filing (G-1055 10/01/26, page 11). The same amount with a consulate, the immigration court or CBP, each giving its own payment instructions.
notes.i212_exempt: Form I-212, $0 (G-1055 10/01/26, page 12) when filed with USCIS by a person seeking or granted a special immigrant visa or status as an Afghan or Iraqi translator or interpreter, U.S. Government or ISAF employee (or a derivative), adjustment as an abused spouse or child under the Cuban Adjustment Act or HRIFA, or immigrant classification as a VAWA self-petitioner (including derivatives). Not listed: SIJ, T or U.
notes.i485_caa: Cuban Adjustment Act and HRIFA dependents (src/cuban_adjustment.py): the general I-485 fee (i485), or i485_under_14_with_parent; an I-765 filed with it pays i765_with_pending_i485_paid. $0 only for the abused spouse or child under CAA or HRIFA, which the system doesn't build (G-1055 10/01/26, I-485 rows).
notes.eoir42a: Form EOIR-42A (cancellation of removal, permanent resident): $730 = $100 EOIR fee + $630 OBBBA fee, for filings on or after 10/01/2026 (EOIR's forms page, justice.gov/eoir/eoir-forms, updated October 1, 2026; 8 CFR 1103.7(b)(4) as amended by 91 FR 54211, FY 2027 inflation adjustment, effective 10/01/2026). Paid only through the EOIR Payment Portal. Not on EOIR's 'Types of Appeals, Motions, and Required Fees' page.
notes.eoir42b: Form EOIR-42B (cancellation of removal, non-permanent resident): $1,690 = $100 EOIR fee + $1,590 OBBBA fee, for filings on or after 10/01/2026 (EOIR's forms page, updated October 1, 2026; 8 CFR 1103.7(b)(4) as amended by 91 FR 54211). Paid only through the EOIR Payment Portal.
notes.dhs_biometrics: The DHS biometric services fee for an EOIR-40, EOIR-42A or EOIR-42B: $30 per person (EOIR's forms page, updated October 1, 2026; Form G-1055 edition 10/01/26, page 2-3). Paid on pay.gov; its confirmation goes to the USCIS lockbox (DHS's instructions for applications in immigration court, revised June 8, 2026, part B). The judge can't waive it (Immigration Court Practice Manual 3.4(e)(iii)).
notes.i360_vawa: Form I-360 self-petition under VAWA (an abused spouse or child of a U.S. citizen or permanent resident, or an abused parent of a U.S. citizen son or daughter): $0 (G-1055 10/01/26, page 14). No Pub. L. 119-21 fee is listed for it. USCIS Policy Manual 3.D.4.A: 'There is no fee when Form I-360 is filed as a VAWA self-petition.'
notes.i485_vawa: Form I-485 filed by a VAWA self-petitioner (including derivatives), Part 2, 3.a: $0 (G-1055 10/01/26, page 16). Its (c)(9) work permit is $0 as well (page 53).
notes.i914: Form I-914, Application for T Nonimmigrant Status: general filing $0 (G-1055 10/01/26). No separate biometric services fee is listed for it.
notes.i914a: Form I-914, Supplement A (family member of a T-1): general filing $0 (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.i914b: Form I-914, Supplement B (the law enforcement declaration): general filing $0 (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.i192_t: Form I-192 filed as an applicant for T nonimmigrant status (including derivatives): $0; general filing $1,100 (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.i131_t: Form I-131, a person seeking or granted T nonimmigrant status or adjustment under INA 245(l): $0 for all reentry permits, travel documents, parole documents and arrival/departure records (G-1055 10/01/26, the I-131 fee exemptions).
notes.i918: Form I-918, Petition for U Nonimmigrant Status, general filing: $0. The G-1055 lists no biometric services fee for it (G-1055 10/01/26, page 28; Form I-918 Instructions 01/20/25: 'There is no filing fee for Form I-918 or Supplement A').
notes.i918a: Form I-918 Supplement A (each qualifying family member): $0 (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.i918b: Form I-918 Supplement B (the certifying official's certification): $0 (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.i192: Form I-192, general filing: $1,100 (G-1055 10/01/26). Not what a U petitioner pays: see i192_u.
notes.i192_u: Form I-192 filed as a petitioner for U nonimmigrant status (including derivatives): $0 (G-1055 10/01/26, page 10).
notes.i821d: Form I-821D (DACA), 'General filing $85' (G-1055 10/01/26, p. 24): one amount (the G-1055 shows no separate online amount). The I-821D Instructions (01/20/25) still say 'There is no filing fee for Form I-821D': the G-1055 governs, and uscis.gov/i-821d (updated 06/01/2026) names 'the $85 filing fee for Form I-821D'. No fee waiver for DACA (uscis.gov/DACA); a fee exemption must be requested and approved BEFORE filing (src/daca.py).
notes.i765_c33: Form I-765 under category (c)(33), consideration of DACA: Paper Filing $520, Online Filing $470 (G-1055 10/01/26, Appendix C, p. 50). Filed with the I-821D, its own payment. No fee waiver (uscis.gov/DACA).
notes.i485_supa: Form I-485 Supplement A (Adjustment of Status Under Section 245(i)), general filing: Paper Filing $1,000, Online Filing $1,000 (G-1055 10/01/26, pages 16-17). Paid by its own Form G-1450, besides the I-485 fee (8 CFR 245.10(c): the additional sum).
notes.i485_supa_under_17: Supplement A: $0 'If you are an unmarried child under 17 years of age' (G-1055 10/01/26, page 17; 8 CFR 245.10(c)(1)).
notes.i485_supa_family_unity: Supplement A: $0 'If you are the spouse or unmarried child under 21 years of age of a legalized alien and have attached a copy of a USCIS receipt or approval notice for a properly filed Form I-817, Application for Family Unity Benefits' (G-1055 10/01/26, page 17; 8 CFR 245.10(c)(2)-(3)).
notes.i864a: Form I-864A (Contract Between Sponsor and Household Member), general filing: $0 (G-1055 10/01/26, page 26).
notes.i864ez: Form I-864EZ (Affidavit of Support Under Section 213A of the INA), general filing: $0 (G-1055 10/01/26, page 26).
notes.i730: Form I-730 (Refugee/Asylee Relative Petition), general filing: $0 (G-1055 10/01/26, page 22). 8 CFR 207.7(d): 'There is no fee for this benefit request.'
notes.i751_abuse_waiver: Form I-751: $0 for a conditional permanent resident, spouse or child who filed a waiver of the joint filing requirement based on battery or extreme cruelty; the general paper fee is i751 (G-1055 10/01/26).
notes.n565: Form N-565, general filing: Paper Filing $555, Online Filing $505 (G-1055 10/01/26, page 31). A fee waiver (Form I-912) is possible (the system doesn't build one for the N-565).
notes.n565_uscis_error: Form N-565 filed because the certificate contains incorrect information due to USCIS error: $0 (G-1055 10/01/26, page 31).
notes.i131_parole: Form I-131, initial parole document for someone outside the U.S. not under a specific parole program (Part 1, item 7): Paper Filing $630, Online Filing $580 (G-1055 10/01/26, Appendix B, page 41). One fee for each person the parole is for. The G-1055's I-131 General Fee Exemptions (a current or former U.S. armed forces service member, SIJ, T, U, a VAWA self-petitioner, an Afghan or Iraqi special immigrant) make it $0 for a person who is one of those: when filing for someone else the exemption applies only if THAT person qualifies (page 41, the asterisk on item 7). Separately, CBP charges the Pub. L. 119-21 Immigration Parole Fee at the port of entry, not with this filing (see pl_119_21.immigration_parole_poe).
notes.i134: Form I-134, Declaration of Financial Support, general filing: $0 (G-1055 10/01/26, page 9).
notes.g639: Form G-639, Freedom of Information/Privacy Act Request: nothing is paid with it. The G-1055 (10/01/26, page 4) says 'USCIS will notify you if a fee must be submitted after we review your request'; the form (edition 12/12/24, Part 3) says do not send payment, and that the request is an agreement to pay up to $25: 'We do not charge for the first 100 copies and two hours of search time, and the remaining combined charges for search and duplication must exceed $14.00 before we will charge you any fees. Search and processing fees are not applicable for Privacy Act requests.'
notes.i821_initial: Form I-821, initial registration for TPS: $510 plus the biometric services fee (G-1055 10/01/26, page 24). Rises to $520 for a request postmarked on or after 10/16/2026 (USCIS alert of 09/30/2026, FY 2027 inflation adjustment: see scheduled).
notes.i821_reregistration: Form I-821, re-registration for TPS: $0 plus the biometric services fee (G-1055 10/01/26, page 24).
notes.i821_biometrics: The biometric services fee that goes with an I-821, initial or re-registration: $30, submitted separately from the filing fee; a fee waiver can cover this fee only (G-1055 10/01/26, page 24).
notes.i765_tps_initial: Form I-765 for an initial TPS work permit, category (a)(12) or (c)(19): Paper Filing $520, plus the Pub. L. 119-21 fee as its own payment (G-1055 10/01/26, Appendix C, page 50).
notes.i765_tps_renewal: Form I-765 renewal under (a)(12) or (c)(19): Paper Filing $520, plus the Pub. L. 119-21 fee as its own payment (G-1055 10/01/26, Appendix C, page 51).
notes.tps_ead_initial: The Pub. L. 119-21 fee for an initial TPS work permit: $560 (G-1055 10/01/26, page 50), $570 for a request postmarked on or after 10/16/2026 (USCIS alert of 09/30/2026). Not waivable.
notes.tps_ead_renewal: The Pub. L. 119-21 fee for a renewal TPS work permit: $280 (G-1055 10/01/26, page 51). Not waivable.
notes.immigration_parole_poe: The Pub. L. 119-21 Immigration Parole Fee: $1,020 (USCIS alert of 09/30/2026), $1,050 from 10/16/2026 (the date of the USCIS alert's increase). CBP collects it each time a person seeks parole at a port of entry, unless CBP finds an exception, so the amount that applies turns on the date of entry, which the filing system cannot know; it is not paid with the I-131 and not waivable (G-1055 10/01/26, Appendix B, pages 40-42). Shown to the paralegal as a note; never a payment in the packet.
